businessType: Refrigerated cold-brew and adaptogen-functional coffee brand, founded 2019. 9 SKUs in 12oz and 32oz refrigerated formats. $14.2M gross (invoiced) revenue TTM. 38 employees. Distribution: ~2,400 retail doors (natural channel + regional conventional grocery), DTC subscription (~9,000 active subscribers), and Amazon. Co-packed at two refrigerated facilities; no owned manufacturing.
stage: Scale-up Series A ($11M raised 2022): Invoiced revenue $14.2M TTM growing 41% YoY, but net revenue (after trade/returns/slotting) only $9.8M. Reported gross margin on invoiced basis 34%, but true contribution margin after trade spend, freight, and spoilage is 11% and falling (was 19% twelve months ago, -800bps). Monthly burn $420k. Cash on hand $3.1M. DTC contribution margin 44%; retail contribution margin now 4%.
ownerGoal: Reach contribution-margin breakeven (>20% blended contribution margin) and a defensible path to profitability within 9 months to unlock a $6M bridge/Series A extension from existing investors.
ownerConstraints: Cash runway 7.4 months at current $420k/month burn; bridge financing is conditional on a credible margin-recovery plan.

Trade spend has grown to 18% of invoiced retail revenue (slotting, scan-down promos, free-fill), versus 9% twelve months ago; two national retailers demand 15%+ promotional frequency to retain shelf space.
Refrigerated DSD/LTL freight runs $0.62/unit and spoilage/short-code returns are 7% of retail shipments due to 90-day code life and slow velocity in newer doors.
Co-pack minimum runs are 8,000 units/SKU; cannot economically reduce SKU count below current run minimums without renegotiation.
Founder has signed 12-month shelf commitments with two national natural retailers (~600 doors) that carry guaranteed promo calendars and cannot be exited without penalty until Q1 next year.
Team is lean (38 people, only 2 in finance/FP&A); no SKU-level or door-level contribution reporting exists today.
immediateConcern: Invoiced revenue is up 41% YoY but the company is burning faster than ever and true contribution margin has fallen from 19% to 11% in twelve months. The founder cannot tell whether the brand is fundamentally unprofitable, whether specific channels/SKUs/doors are dragging the blend, or whether trade spend is buying unprofitable distribution. Investors will not release the bridge without a credible margin story within 60 days.
